title: Weeknight Sweet Mediterranean Lamb Casserole
description: A comforting, sweet, and crumbly weeknight Mediterranean dish featuring coconut milk and a crunchy lamb topping.
instructions: In a large baking dish, grease the bottom with olive oil.
In a large skillet, cook the lamb shoulder over medium-high heat until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the lamb to the prepared baking dish.
Cook the chopped onion and minced garlic in the skillet until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the dried oregano, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Pour the coconut milk over the lamb and onion mixture.
Bring the coconut milk to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes or until the sauce thickens slightly.
Top the lamb with crumbled feta cheese (if using) and chopped fresh parsley.
In a small bowl, mix together the crushed almonds and a pinch of salt.
Sprinkle the almond mixture evenly over the top of the lamb.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes or until the lamb is cooked through and the top is golden brown.
